inlines.v: REF'ERABLE, adjective 1. That may be referred; capable of being considered in relation to something else. 2. That may be assigned; that may be considered as belonging to or related to. It is a question among philosophers, whether all the attractions which obtain between bodies, are referable to one general cause.
